title: Saudi intelligence chief meets Iraqi PM, renews Riyadh visit invitation
english: The Saudi intelligence chief visited Baghdad to meet with Iraq’s Prime Minister in an effort to repair diplomatic relations damaged by deadly joint US-Saudi airstrikes last month. During the meeting, the Saudi official formally invited the Prime Minister to visit Riyadh again after a previous trip was canceled in protest of the attacks. Both leaders discussed improving security coordination while the Iraqi government reaffirmed its commitment to preventing its territory from being used for regional conflicts.
amharic: የሳዑዲ የደህንነት መረጃ ሃላፊ ባለፈው ወር በተፈጸመው የአየር ጥቃት የተበላሸውን የሁለቱን ሀገራት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ለማደስ በባግዳድ ከኢራቅ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጋር ተወያይተዋል። የሳዑዲው ባለስልጣን ከዚህ ቀደም በአየር ጥቃቱ ምክንያት ተሰርዞ የነበረውን የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩን የሪያድ ጉብኝት ዳግም እንዲያደርጉ ግብዣ አቅርበዋል። የኢራቅ መሪም ሀገራቸው ለሌላ ሀገር ጥቃት መነሻ እንዳትሆን የገቡትን ቃል በማደስ በፀጥታ ጉዳዮች ላይ የሁለቱ ሀገራት ቅንጅት እንዲሻሻል ተወያይተዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan basaasaa Saudii ji'a darbe ajjeechaa fi miidhaa geessiseen booda hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii fooyyessuuf Bagdaaditti muummee ministira Iraaq waliin wal arganiiru. Qondaalli Saudii kun erga haleellaa sanaan walqabatee daawwannaan muummee ministirichaa erga haqamee booda, akka ammas Riyaad daawwatan afeerraa dhiyeessaniiru. Hoggantoonni lamaan kunneen qindoomina nageenyaa irratti mari'atan yoo ta'u, muummeen ministirichaa biyyi isaanii iddoo haleellaa biyya biraarra itti geggeeffamu akka hin taane mirkaneessaniiru.

title: US Senate passes Russia sanctions that could hurt India and China
english: The United States Senate has approved a significant package of sanctions against Russia, marking one of the most assertive actions taken during the Trump administration. These new measures include potential tariffs that could negatively impact countries like India and China, which are major importers of Russian goods. This legislative move signals an escalation in US economic pressure aimed at penalizing Russia.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴኔት በሩሲያ ላይ ጠንካራ ማዕቀቦችን የያዘ አዲስ ህግ አጽድቋል። ይህ እርምጃ በሩሲያ ላይ ከፍተኛ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጫና ለመፍጠር ያለመ ሲሆን፣ እንደ ሕንድ እና ቻይና ያሉ የሩሲያ ምርቶችን በብዛት የሚገዙ አገራት ላይ የጉምሩክ ቀረጥ በመጣል ሊጎዳ ይችላል። ይህ የሕግ አውጭው አካል ውሳኔ በሩሲያ ላይ የሚደረገውን የኢኮኖሚ ግፊት የሚያጠናክር ነው።
oromo: Mana maree seera baastuu Ameerikaa (US Senate) tarkaanfii cimaa fi seera sancii (sanctions) Raashiyaa irratti dabarsuuf qophiidha. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyoota akka Indiyaa fi Chaayinaa kanneen oomisha Raashiyaa hedduu bitatan irratti gibira dabalataa gaafachuu danda'a. Seerri kun dhiibbaa diinagdee Raashiyaa irratti qabu cimsuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Submerged Indonesian village re-emerges as drought lowers water levels
english: A village in Indonesia that was previously underwater has become visible again due to a significant drop in water levels caused by the dry season. Drone recordings show the remnants of buildings appearing in the Karian Reservoir. Authorities have confirmed that the facility is still operating safely despite the water level dropping by nearly a meter.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዥያ የካሪያን ግድብ ውስጥ በውሃ ተውጦ የነበረ መንደር በደረቅ ወቅቱ ምክንያት የውሃው መጠን በመቀነሱ ዳግም ብቅ ብሏል። በድሮን በተነሱ ምስሎች የመንደሩ ቅሪቶች በግልጽ ይታያሉ። ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት የውሃው መጠን በ80 ሳንቲሜትር ቢቀንስም ግድቡ አሁንም ደህንነቱ በተጠበቀ ሁኔታ እየሰራ ይገኛል።
oromo: Indoneziyaatti, guddina bishaanii Kaariyaan jedhamu keessa kan ture gandii tokko, yeroo gogansaa kanatti sadarkaan bishaanii hirrachuu isaatiin darbee mul'achuu jalqabeera. Suuraawwan dirooniin kaafaman akka agarsiisanitti, manneen ganda sanaa bishaan keessaa ba'anii mul'atu. Itti gaafatamtoonni akka jedhanitti, sadarkaan bishaanii seentimeetira 80 kan hirrate ta'us, bu'uurichi ammas nagaa ta'ee hojjechaa jira.

title: US courts clear way for deportations of South Sudan, Myanmar nationals
english: US federal judges have ruled that the Trump administration may officially end Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for nationals from South Sudan and Myanmar. This decision removes deportation immunity and work authorization for thousands of individuals currently living in the country. Legal advocates expressed concern that these people now face removal to nations still suffering from severe instability and conflict.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌደራል ዳኞች የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከደቡብ ሱዳን እና ከማያንማር ለመጡ ዜጎች ይሰጥ የነበረውን ጊዜያዊ የጥበቃ ሁኔታ (TPS) ማቋረጥ እንደሚችል ወስነዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በአሜሪካ የሚኖሩ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ስደተኞች ከሀገር እንዳይባረሩ የሚያደርገውን ህጋዊ ከለላ እና የስራ ፈቃድ ያስወግዳል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾችም እነዚህ ሰዎች አሁንም ግጭት እና አለመረጋጋት ወደሚታይባቸው ሀገራቸው እንዲመለሱ መገደዳቸው አሳሳቢ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Abbootiin seeraa federaalaa Ameerikaa mootummaan Traamp lammiilee Sudaan Kibbaa fi Miyaanmaar irratti eegumsa yeroo (TPS) jedhamu akka dhaabuuf heyyamaniiru. Murtuun kun namoota kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman biyyattii keessa jiraatan irratti eegumsa arii'atamuu irraa ittisuu fi hayyama hojii irraa kaasa. Dhimma baqattootaa irratti kanneen falman, namoonni kun gara biyyoota waraana fi jeequmsaan guutamanitti deebifamuun isaanii yaaddoo guddaa akka ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: What could the Mecca defence pact mean for the US role in the Middle East?
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, a new pact stating that an attack on one nation will be considered an attack on all three. This move reflects a growing trend among regional powers to build independent security networks, driven by long-standing doubts about the reliability of United States support. While these countries are not trying to completely replace American influence, they are actively seeking to broaden their strategic options in light of the ongoing US-Israel conflict with Iran.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን በመካ የተፈራረሙት የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት በአንዱ አገር ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሦስቱም አገራት ላይ እንደተፈጸመ ይቆጠራል ሲል ይደነግጋል። ይህ ስምምነት በአሜሪካ የጸጥታ ዋስትና ላይ እያደገ የመጣውን ጥርጣሬ ተከትሎ አገራቱ የራሳቸውን የጋራ መከላከያ አማራጮች ለመፍጠር እያደረጉት ያለውን ጥረት ያሳያል። አገራቱ የአሜሪካን ተጽዕኖ ሙሉ በሙሉ ለመተካት ባይሞክሩም፣ በእስራኤል እና ኢራን መካከል ያለው ጦርነት ባስከተለው አለመረጋጋት ምክንያት የየራሳቸውን ደህንነት ለማጠናከር እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Turkii fi Paakistaan walii galtee ittisa biyyaalessaa kan Mecca jedhamu kan mallatteessan yoo ta'u, kunis biyyoota sadan keessaa tokko irratti yoo haleellaan raawwatame akka isa sadaniinuutti ilaalamu ibsa. Tarkaanfiin kun shakkii biyyoonni naannichaa gargaarsa amansiisummaa Ameerikaa irratti qaban irraa kan maddeedha. Biyyoonni kun dhiibbaa Ameerikaa guutummaatti bakka buusuuf kan hin yaalle ta'us, waraana Ameerikaa fi Israa'el Itoophiyaa waliin godhamaa jiruun wal qabatee nageenya isaanii mirkaneeffachuuf mala biraa barbaachisaa jiru.

title: Trump shifts blame to Republicans for waning support from public
english: President Donald Trump is attributing his declining popularity to the actions and decisions of Republican lawmakers. These senators are currently distancing themselves from the President by avoiding controversial votes during their summer recess. Key political tensions fueling this divide include disagreements over potential conflict with Iran and public pressure to disclose information regarding the Epstein files.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የህዝብ ድጋፋቸው እየቀነሰ የመጣው በሪፐብሊካን የህግ አውጪዎች ድርጊት እና ውሳኔዎች ምክንያት እንደሆነ ይናገራሉ። እነዚህ የሴኔት አባላት በበጋው የእረፍት ጊዜያቸው አወዛጋቢ የሆኑ ድምጾችን ከመስጠት በመቆጠብ ከፕሬዝዳንቱ እየራቁ ይገኛሉ። ለዚህ ክፍፍል ምክንያት ከሆኑት ዋና ዋና ጉዳዮች መካከል ከኢራን ጋር ሊፈጠር የሚችለው ጦርነት እና የኤፕስታይን ፋይሎችን እንዲለቀቁ የሚቀርበው የህዝብ ጥያቄ ይጠቀሳሉ።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolaard Tiraamp deggersi isaanii ummata biratti hir'achaa kan jiru tarkaanfii fi murtoo miseensota paartii Ripaabilikaanii irraa kan ka'e ta'uu ibsaniiru. Miseensonni seeneetii kunneen guyyoota boqonnaa gannaa keessatti sagalee kennuu irraa of qusachuun pireezidaanticha irraa fagaachaa jiru. Walitti bu'iinsa kanaaf kan sababa ta'an dhimmoonni gurguddoon waraana biyya Iraan waliin uumamuu danda'uufi gabaasni 'Epstein' akka ifa bahu dhiibbaa uummata irraa dhufee dha.

title: Colombia’s new president takes office vowing to ‘crush’ narco-terrorism
english: Abelardo De La Espriella has officially become the president of Colombia following a tight electoral victory in June. He has committed his administration to aggressively fighting drug-related violence and terrorism. Additionally, the new leader plans to focus on economic growth and strengthening diplomatic ties with the United States.
amharic: አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪኤላ በሰኔ ወር በተካሄደው ጠባብ የምርጫ ውጤት አሸናፊ በመሆን የኮሎምቢያ ፕሬዝዳንት ሆነው ተሹመዋል። አዲሱ ፕሬዝዳንት በአገሪቱ ያለውን የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውርና ሽብርተኝነት ለመዋጋት ቃል ገብተዋል። እንዲሁም የኢኮኖሚ ተግዳሮቶችን በመፍታት ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያላቸውን የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር አቅደዋል።
oromo: Abelardo De La Espriella erga filannoo ji'a Waxabajjii mo'atee booda pirezidaantii Kolombiyaa ta'e muudameera. Innis nageenya biyyattii eeguuf jecha yakka gurgurtaa sammuu namaa hadoochan fi shororkeessummaa irratti duuluuf waadaa galeera. Kana malees, jijjiirama dinagdee fiduu fi hariiroo dippilomaasii Ameerikaa wajjin qaban cimsuuf karoorfateera.

title: De la Espriella sworn in as Colombia’s leader, vows armed group crackdown
english: Abelardo de la Espriella has been inaugurated as Colombia's new president, marking a significant shift toward right-wing leadership. The former lawyer has pledged to abandon peace negotiations with armed groups in favor of a militaristic crackdown to restore national stability. His administration also plans to revive the oil and gas sector while significantly reducing government spending.
amharic: አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪኤላ የኮሎምቢያ አዲሱ ፕሬዝዳንት ሆነው የተሾሙ ሲሆን ይህም በአገሪቱ የፖለቲካ አቅጣጫ ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ ፈጥሯል። የቀድሞው ጠበቃ ከታጠቁ ቡድኖች ጋር የሚደረገውን የሰላም ድርድር በማቆም፣ በአገሪቱ መረጋጋትን ለማስፈን ጥብቅ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ቃል ገብተዋል። አዲሱ አስተዳደር የነዳጅ እና ጋዝ ኢንዱስትሪን ለማነቃቃት እና የመንግስት ወጪን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ለመቀነስ እቅድ አለው።
oromo: Abelardo de la Espriella pirezidaantii haaraa Kolombiyaa ta'uun kakuu raawwateera; kunis jijjiirama siyaasaa gara mirgaatti godhame kan agarsiisuudha. Inni duraan abukaatoo ture kun, gareewwan hidhatan wajjin marii nagaa gochuu dhaabuudhaan, nageenya biyyattii kabachiisuuf tarkaanfii waraanaa cimaa fudhachuuf waadaa galeera. Mootummaan isaa damee boba'aa fi gaazii deebisee jajjabeessuufi baasii mootummaa hir'isuuf karoorfateera.

title: CNN: Top general says US needs ‘off ramp’ from Iran war
english: A senior US military leader has advised the Trump administration to seek a diplomatic solution to avoid further escalation with Iran. General Dan Caine expressed concerns that relying solely on airstrikes would be ineffective and potentially counterproductive. He has held discussions with key administration officials regarding alternative strategies to de-escalate the ongoing tensions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ መኮንን የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከኢራን ጋር ያለውን ግጭት ለመቀነስ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄ እንዲፈልግ መክረዋል። ጄኔራል ዳን ኬን በአየር ጥቃት ብቻ መተማመን ውጤታማ አለመሆኑን እና ሁኔታውን የበለጠ እንደሚያባብሰው ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ጉዳዩን በተመለከተ ከዋና ዋና የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ጋር አማራጭ የመፍትሄ መንገዶችን ተወያይተዋል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraanaa olaantuun Ameerikaa tokko mootummaan Trump walitti buiinsa Iran waliin jiru tasgabbeessuuf karaa diippilomaasii akka barbaadu gorsaniiru. Jeneraal Daan Keeniin, haleellaa qilleensa qofaan irratti hunda’uun bu’aa hin qabu akkasumas rakkoo caalu fiduu danda’a jechuun yaaddoo ibsaniiru. Dhimma kana ilaalchisee gaggeessitoota mootummaa kanneen biroo waliin karaa biroo ittiin waldhabdee kana furuun danda’amu irratti mari’ataniiru.

title: Turkish, Pakistani and Saudi flags shine in Kingdom's cities
english: Saudi Arabia recently illuminated major city landmarks with the flags of Turkey, Pakistan, and itself to celebrate the signing of the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement. This new pact highlights a collaborative effort between the three nations to boost regional security and maintain global stability. By entering this partnership, the countries aim to foster a safer and more prosperous future for everyone.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ የመካ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነትን መፈረሟን ተከትሎ የቱርክን፣ የፓኪስታንን እና የራሷን ባንዲራዎች በዋና ዋና የከተማዋ ሕንፃዎች ላይ አሳይታለች። ይህ ስምምነት በሶስቱ አገራት መካከል የክልሉን ደህንነት ለማጠናከር እና ዓለም አቀፍ ሰላምን ለመጠበቅ ያለውን የጋራ ቁርጠኝነት የሚያሳይ ነው። አገራቱ በዚህ አጋርነት አማካኝነት ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ እና የተሻለ ብልጽግና ያለው የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ ለመፍጠር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan waliigaltee ittisa gamtaa Makkaa mallatteessuu ishee hordofee, alaandawwan biyyoota Turkii, Paakistaanii fi kan ishee magaalonni gurguddoon itti ifanii jiru. Waliigalteen kun nageenya naannichaa cimsuu fi tasgabbii guutuu addunyaa mirkaneessuuf biyyoonni sadan waliin hojjechuuf fedhii qaban kan mul'isu dha. Gamtaan kun gara fuulduraatti jireenya tasgabbii qabuu fi badhaadhaa ta'e uumuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Muslim nations, organisations welcome Saudi Arabia-Turkey-Pakistan defence pact
english: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have officially entered into a new trilateral defense agreement to strengthen regional security and cooperation. Various Muslim-majority nations and international organizations have praised the pact as a vital step toward ensuring long-term stability in the area. Supporters believe this strategic partnership will foster solidarity and help address the growing security challenges currently facing the Islamic world.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ፓኪስታን የክልሉን ደህንነት እና ትብብር ለማጠናከር የሚያስችል አዲስ የጋራ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። የተለያዩ የእስልምና ሀገራት እና ዓለም አቀፍ ተቋማት ይህ ስምምነት በክልሉ ዘላቂ ሰላም ለመፍጠር ትልቅ ሚና ይኖረዋል ሲሉ አወድሰውታል። የዚህ ስምምነት ደጋፊዎች የዚህ ስትራቴጂካዊ አጋርነት መፈጠር በኢስላማዊው ዓለም ውስጥ ያለውን አንድነት በማጠናከር አሁን የተጋረጡ የደህንነት ስጋቶችን ለመቅረፍ እንደሚረዳ ያምናሉ።
oromo: Turkiin, Sa'udii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan nageenyaa fi walta'iinsa naannichaa cimsuuf waliigaltee ittisaa haaraa waliin mallatteessaniiru. Biyyoonni Islaamaa fi dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa garaagaraa waliigaltee kana naannichatti tasgabbii fiduuf tarkaanfii barbaachisaa ta'e jechuun galateeffataniiru. Deggertoonni walta'iinsi kun tokkummaa biyyoota Islaamaa cimsuu fi rakkoolee nageenyaa yeroo ammaa mudachaa jiran furuuf gumaacha guddaa qaba jedhanii amanu.

title: Oman 'facing environmental disaster' as tanker leaks off its coast
english: An old oil tanker, believed to be part of Russia's shadow fleet, is leaking a massive oil slick near a protected marine area off the coast of Oman. The vessel has been stranded for several weeks following unexplained explosions, and the spread of oil has reached hundreds of square kilometers. Environmental organizations are warning that this incident could cause a long-lasting ecological disaster in the region.
amharic: የሩሲያ የጥላ መርከቦች ቡድን አካል ነው የተባለ የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከብ በኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የነዳጅ መፍሰስ እያደረሰ ይገኛል። መርከቧ ያልታወቀ ፍንዳታ ካጋጠማት በኋላ ላለፉት ጥቂት ሳምንታት ተጣብቃ የቆየች ሲሆን፣ የፈሰሰው ነዳጅ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ካሬ ኪሎ ሜትሮችን እንዲሸፍን አድርጓል። የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ተቋማት ይህ አደጋ በአካባቢው ላይ ከፍተኛ እና የረጅም ጊዜ ስነ-ምህዳራዊ ጉዳት ሊያስከትል እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Markabni boba'aa kan 'shadow fleet' Ruusiyaa ta'e jedhamee shakkamu tokko, qarqara galaana Omaanitti boba'aa dhangalaasuun balaa naannoo mudachuu akka danda'u ibsameera. Markabni kun erga dhohiinsa ifa hin taaneen miidhamee torbanoota hedduuf achumaan dhaabatee kan ture yoo ta'u, dhangala'aan boba'ichaa lafa bal'ina isaa kiilomeetira iskuweerii dhibbaan lakka'amu haguugeera. Dhaabbileen naannoo eegan akka jedhanitti, balaan kun miidhaa ekoloojii cimaa fi yeroo dheeraa turuu danda'u qaqqabsiisuu akka danda'u akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Sudan’s war threatens an ‘entire generation’s’ future, UN warns
english: The ongoing civil war in Sudan has severely crippled the country's education system, leaving over eight million children without access to schooling. United Nations officials warn that the destruction of most schools and the constant threat of violence are robbing an entire generation of their future. Despite efforts to provide alternative learning, the situation remains dire as children face displacement, instability, and a lack of resources.
amharic: በሱዳን እየተካሄደ ያለው የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት የሀገሪቱን የትምህርት ሥርዓት በእጅጉ በመጉዳቱ ከስምንት ሚሊዮን በላይ ህጻናት ከትምህርት ገበታ ውጪ ሆነዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እንደገለጸው፣ አብዛኛዎቹ ትምህርት ቤቶች በመውደማቸው እና በጦርነቱ ምክንያት አንድ ሙሉ ትውልድ የወደፊት ተስፋውን እያጣ ነው። ምንም እንኳን ህጻናትን ወደ ትምህርት ለመመለስ ጥረቶች ቢደረጉም፣ የህጻናቱ መፈናቀል እና የጸጥታ ችግሮች ሁኔታውን ይበልጥ አስቸጋሪ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Waraanni biyya Sudaan keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru sirna barnootaa guutummaatti miidhuun ijoollee miliyoona saddeet ol mana barnootaa akka dhaban godheera. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka akeekkachiisetti, manneen barnootaa hedduun barbadaa'uu fi naannichi walitti bu'iinsaan guutamuun dhaloota tokko guutummaatti gara fuulduraa isaanii dhabsiisaa jira. Hojjettoonni gargaarsaa ijoollee barnootatti deebisuuf yaalii gochaa jiranis, buqqa'uu fi nageenya dhabuun rakkoo kana daran ulfaataa taasiseera.

title: Puerto Rico rations water as severe drought leaves reservoirs depleted
english: Puerto Rico has initiated water rationing for approximately 180,000 homes due to an intense drought that has significantly lowered reservoir levels. Residents in the affected areas are currently depending on water tankers and emergency storage tanks to meet their daily needs. The authorities implemented these strict measures as dry weather conditions continue to persist across the island.
amharic: በፖርቶ ሪኮ በተከሰተው ከፍተኛ ድርቅ የውሃ ማጠራቀሚያዎች በመድረቃቸው ከ180,000 በላይ ለሚሆኑ አባወራዎች የውሃ አጠቃቀም ተወስኗል። በችግሩ የተጎዱ ነዋሪዎች የዕለት ተዕለት ፍላጎታቸውን ለማሟላት በውሃ መኪኖች እና በጊዜያዊ የውሃ ማጠራቀሚያዎች ላይ ጥገኛ ሆነዋል። ደረቅ የአየር ሁኔታው እየቀጠለ በመምጣቱ ባለሥልጣናቱ እነዚህን ጥብቅ እርምጃዎች ለመውሰድ ተገደዋል።
oromo: Puerto Rico keessatti roobni roobuu dhabuun isaa fi hongeen cimaan mudate qulqullina bishaan manca’ee bishaan hir’achuun isaa mana 180,000 ol ta’aniif bishaan hirunni akka gaggeeffamu dirqisiiseera. Jiraattonni naannoo sanaa barbaachisummaa bishaan guyyuu isaanii guuttachuuf konkolaattota bishaan baatan fi kuusaa bishaanitti fayyadamaa jiru. Haalli qilleensa gogsoon itti fufuu isaa hordofee, qaamoleen mootummaa tarkaanfiiwwan cimaa kana fudhachuuf dirqamaniiru.

title: US Senate passes sweeping Russian energy sanctions bill amid Ukraine war
english: The U.S. Senate has approved a significant sanctions bill aimed at crippling Russia's energy revenue during its ongoing war in Ukraine. The legislation imposes 100 percent tariffs on Russian oil and gas imports and targets illicit shipping networks used to bypass existing trade restrictions. This bipartisan measure, which now awaits a vote in the House of Representatives, is intended to cut off funding for the Russian military and pressure Moscow to engage in peace negotiations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴኔት በዩክሬን ላይ እያደረሰ ያለውን ወረራ ለመግታት በሩሲያ የኢነርጂ ዘርፍ ላይ ጠንካራ ማዕቀቦችን መጽደቁን ተከትሎ አዲስ ህግ አውጥቷል። ህጉ በሩሲያ ነዳጅ እና ጋዝ ላይ መቶ በመቶ ታሪፍ የሚጥል ሲሆን፣ ማዕቀቡን በሕገ-ወጥ መንገድ የሚያልፉ የባህር ትራንስፖርት መረቦችንም ያነጣጠረ ነው። ይህ በሁለቱም የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች ድጋፍ ያገኘው ውሳኔ የሩሲያን የጦር መሣሪያ የገንዘብ ምንጭ በማድረቅ ወደ ድርድር ጠረጴዛ እንድትመጣ ለማድረግ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Seneetiin Ameerikaa waraana Yukreen irratti geggeeffamaa jiru dhaabsisuuf jecha, bu'uuraalee dinagdee Raashiyaa irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf seera haaraa raggaasee jira. Seerichi gabaa oomisha boba'aa fi gaazii Raashiyaa irratti gibira dhibbeentaa dhibba (100%) kan gateessu yoo ta'u, seeraa ala marraa ykn dooniiwwan murtiiwwan duraanii cabsuudhaan fayyadamanis kan qoratu dha. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyattiin maallaqa waraanaaf ittiin fayyadamtu akka dhabduu fi gara mariitti akka dhufu dhiibbaa gochuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Iran war live: Trilateral Mecca defence pact signed, as Hormuz deal looms
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have established a new mutual defense agreement in Mecca, treating an attack on one as an act of aggression against all three. Meanwhile, Iran and Oman are discussing a framework to manage activity in the Strait of Hormuz, pending final approval from higher authorities. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian stated that while his country opposes regional conflict, it remains committed to resisting external pressure.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን በመካ ከተማ አዲስ የጋራ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ስምምነቱ በአንዱ ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሦስቱም ላይ እንደተሰነዘረ ይቆጠራል ይላል። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር አጠቃቀም ላይ እየተወያዩ ሲሆን፣ ኢራን ጦርነት እንደማትፈልግ ነገር ግን ግፊትን እንደማትቀበል አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Saudi Arabiyaan, Turkiifi Paakistaan magaala Makkaatti waliigaltee ittisaa waliinii kan mallatteessan yoo ta'u, isaaniin keessaa tokko irratti miidhaan yoo ga'e akka guutuu isaaniitti fudhatama jedhaniiru. Gama biraatiin, Iraaniifi Omaan qajeelfama daandii bishaan Hormuz to'atu irratti mari'achaa jiru. Prezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeskiyaan biyyi isaanii waraana akka hin barbaanne garuu dhiibbaa irra gahu kamiyyuu akka hin fudhanne ibsaniiru.

title: Donald Trump renews effort to fire Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook
english: President Donald Trump has renewed his attempt to remove Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook by threatening her with unsubstantiated mortgage fraud allegations. The administration claims she acted with negligence, though critics view this as a politically motivated move to gain control over interest rate decisions. This unprecedented action challenges the long-standing independence of the US central bank, which is legally designed to operate free from executive interference.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የፌዴራል ሪዘርቭ ቦርድ አባል የሆኑትን ሊዛ ኩክን ያለ ማስረጃ በቤት ብድር ማጭበርበር በመክሰስ ከሥራቸው ለማባረር ዳግም ጥረት ጀምረዋል። አስተዳደሩ በኩክ ላይ የቸልተኝነት ክስ ቢመሰርትም፣ ጉዳዩ የወለድ ምጣኔን ለመቆጣጠር የሚደረግ የፖለቲካ ጫና እንደሆነ ይታያል። ይህ ድርጊት አሜሪካ ከፖለቲካ ጣልቃ ገብነት ነጻ አድርጋ የምታየውን የሀገሪቱን ማዕከላዊ ባንክ ነጻነት የሚፈታተን ታይቶ የማይታወቅ እርምጃ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolaald Tiraamp miseensa boordii Federaal Rizeervii Liizaa Kuuk irratti himannaa sobaa fayyadamuun hojii irraa ari'uuf carraaqqii isaa haaromseera. Mootummaan isaa Kuuk irratti himannaa tuffii fi yakka qabeenyaa dhiyeessus, kun dhiibbaa siyaasaa fayyadamuun dhimmota qananii (interest rate) to’achuuf kan godhamu ta'uun shakkameera. Gochi kun dhaabbanni maallaqaa biyyattii aangoo siyaasaa irraa bilisa ta'ee akka hojjatuuf seeraan kan eegamu ta'us, dhiibbaa inni irratti godhuun kan waggoota dheeraaf turaa ture kun kan diigamu ta'uu agarsiisa.

title: Arab League secretary-general condemns Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia
english: The head of the Arab League has officially denounced a recent Houthi missile or drone strike against Saudi Arabia's Najran region. This offensive resulted in injuries to a number of innocent civilians in the area. The organization expressed its strong support for Saudi Arabia and warned that these hostile actions are endangering regional stability.
amharic: የዐረብ ሊግ ዋና ጸሐፊ በሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ የናጅራን ክልል ላይ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት አውግዘዋል። ጥቃቱ በርካታ ንፁሃን ዜጎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ሊጉ ከሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ ጎን እንደሚቆም ገልጸው፣ እንዲህ ያሉ ቀጣይ ጥቃቶች በክልሉ ሰላም ላይ አደጋ እንደሚደቅኑ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan Gamtaa Arabaa haleellaa gareen Hutiin naannoo Najraan kan Saudii Arabiyaatti raawwate balaaleffateera. Haleellaa kanaan namoonni nagaa hedduun miidhamaniiru. Gamtaan sun Saudii Arabiyaa waliin akka dhaabbatu ibsuun, haleellaan kun tasgabbii naannichaa miidha jiraachuu akeekkachiiseera.

title: Lebanon's Health Ministry says Israeli attacks have killed 4,335 people since 2 March
english: The Lebanese Health Ministry reports that over 4,300 people have been killed and more than 12,000 injured by Israeli military strikes since early March. While Israeli forces remain in parts of southern Lebanon, diplomatic efforts are underway to facilitate a ceasefire and oversee the disarmament of Hezbollah. Officials are currently finalizing a list of international partners to help monitor the situation under a proposed US-led agreement.
amharic: የሊባኖስ ጤና ጥበቃ ሚኒስቴር ከማርች ወር መጀመሪያ አንስቶ በእስራኤል በተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ከ4,300 በላይ ሰዎች መሞታቸውን እና ከ12,000 በላይ መቁሰላቸውን አስታውቋል። የእስራኤል ጦር በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የተወሰኑ አካባቢዎችን ተቆጣጥሮ ቢቆይም፣ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቶች እየተደረጉ ነው። በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት የሂዝቦላህን ትጥቅ መፍታት የሚከታተሉ ዓለም አቀፍ ቡድኖችን ለመምረጥ ስምምነት ላይ እየተደረሰ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ministeerri Fayyaa Libaanos akka ibsetti, gaafa ji'a Bitootessaa jalqabee weerara Israa'el gaggeessiteen namoonni 4,300 ol du'anii 12,000 ol ammoo miidhamaniiru. Waraanni Israa'el kutaa Kibba Libaanos to'achuu isaa itti fufus, mariin nagaa fi waldhabdee dhaabuuf xiyyeeffannoon kennameef jira. Mootummoonni lamaan gareen Hizbollaa meeshaa hiikkachuu isaa hordofuu kan danda'an biyyoota filachuuf walii galtee irra ga'aa jiru.

title: Will Pakistan-Saudi-Turkiye alliance actually create a new regional order?
english: Turkiye, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have established a new mutual defense agreement known as the Mecca Joint Defence Pact. This alliance aims to address regional security concerns as these nations navigate the ongoing tensions between Iran and Israel. While the agreement signifies a united front, experts remain uncertain about the actual military commitment each nation will provide if one is attacked.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ እና ፓኪስታን በመካ የተፈረመ 'የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት' የተሰኘ አዲስ የትብብር ስምምነት አድርገዋል። ይህ ጥምረት በኢራን እና በእስራኤል መካከል እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የክልሉን የፀጥታ ስጋት ለመጋፈጥ ያለመ ነው። ስምምነቱ የአጋሮቹን አንድነት የሚያሳይ ቢሆንም፣ ከሦስቱ አገራት አንዱ ጥቃት ቢደርስበት ሌሎቹ አገራት ምን ያህል ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ እንደሚያደርጉ እስካሁን ግልጽ አይደለም።
oromo: Turkiin, Sa'udii Arabiyaafi Paakistaan walii-galtee ittisa biyyaalessaa kan 'Mecca Joint Defence Pact' jedhamu mallatteessaniiru. Walii-galteen kun waldhabdee gidduu Iraaniifi Israa'el jiru hordofee nageenya naannichaa eeggachuuf kan karoorfame dha. Ta'us, biyyoonni kunneen tokkummaa isaanii kan agarsiisan ta'us, yoo tokko irratti haleellaan raawwatame biyyoonni kaan hangam hammaatti gargaarsa waraanaa akka godhan sirritti ifa hin taane.

title: Medics among six Palestinians injured in Israeli attacks across West Bank
english: Israeli forces and settlers recently carried out a series of attacks across the West Bank, resulting in injuries to six Palestinians, including two paramedics. The incidents involved physical assaults, vandalism of property, and stone-throwing at ambulances responding to emergency situations. These events are part of a broader trend of escalating violence in the region, which has led to thousands of casualties and arrests since the beginning of the year.
amharic: የእስራኤል ኃይሎች እና ሰፋሪዎች በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ባደረሱት ተከታታይ ጥቃት ሁለት የህክምና ባለሙያዎችን ጨምሮ ስድስት ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል። በናብሉስ እና በቤተልሔም በተፈጸሙት ጥቃቶች አካላዊ ጉዳቶች የደረሱ ሲሆን በአምቡላንስ ላይም ድንጋይ በመወርወር የህክምና አገልግሎት ሰጪዎች ተጎድተዋል። እነዚህ ክስተቶች ከጥር ወር ጀምሮ በክልሉ እየጨመረ የመጣው የሁከት አካል ሲሆኑ፣ እስካሁን በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ጉዳትና እስር አስተናግደዋል።
oromo: Humnootni Israa'el fi qonnaan bultoonni biyya lafaa mudde 2026 keessa iddoowwan garaa garaa Naablus fi Beetlehemitti gaggeessaniin, ogeeyyota fayyaa lama dabalatee Palasxinoonni ja'a miidhamaniiru. Humni kun namoota irratti haleellaa qaamaa raawwachuu fi konkolaataa ambulaansii dhagaadhaan rukutuun miidhaa geessiseera. Gochi kun rakkoo yeroo dheeraaf bakkeewwan kanneenitti itti fufe keessaa kan dhihoo ta'ee, hanga ammaatti namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman miidhamuu fi hidhamuun isaanii gabaafameera.

title: Kpler: Hormuz traffic subdued, surges 18 percent through Bab el-Mandeb
english: Maritime traffic data from August 7 shows a significant shift in regional shipping activity. While crossings through the Strait of Hormuz dropped by one-third, ship movement through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait increased by 18 percent. Officials reported no new attacks on vessels during this period, despite the ongoing fluctuations in maritime transit patterns.
amharic: የነሐሴ 7 የባህር ላይ መረጃ እንደሚያሳየው በክልሉ የንግድ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ ታይቷል። በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል የሚደረገው የመርከብ ጉዞ በ33 በመቶ የቀነሰ ሲሆን፣ በባብ ኤል-ማንደብ በኩል ያለው እንቅስቃሴ ግን በ18 በመቶ ጨምሯል። ምንም እንኳን የትራፊክ ፍሰቱ ቢለዋወጥም፣ በዚህ ወቅት በመርከቦች ላይ የተፈጸመ አዲስ ጥቃት አለመኖሩ ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Odeeffannoon markabaa guyyaa Hagayya 7 akka agarsiisutti, sochiin markaboota naannichaa jijjiirama guddaa qaba. Daandiin Hormuz imala markaboota irraa dhibbeentaa 33 gadi bu'eera, garuu karaa Bab el-Mandeb imalli markaboota dhibbeentaa 18 dabaleera. Haala jijjiirama kana keessattuu, yeroo kanatti markaboota irratti haleellaan haaraan akka hin raawwatamne ibsameera.

title: OIC, former Qatari PM welcome Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan defence pact
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have officially signed the Mecca Agreement, a new defense pact aimed at strengthening regional security. The Organisation of Islamic Cooperation praised the move as a major step toward stabilizing the Muslim world. Former Qatari Prime Minister Hamad bin Jassim also expressed his support, noting that the alliance is a promising development.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን የክልሉን ደህንነት ለማጠናከር ያለመ የመከላከያ ስምምነት በይፋ ተፈራርመዋል። የእስልምና ትብብር ድርጅት ይህንን ስምምነት ለሙስሊም ዓለም መረጋጋት ትልቅ አስተዋፅዖ ያለው እርምጃ ነው ሲል አድንቋል። የቀድሞው የኳታር ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሃማድ ቢን ጃሲም በበኩላቸው፣ ስምምነቱ ለወደፊት ተስፋ ሰጪ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Turkii fi Paakistaan nageenya naannichaa cimsuuf walii galtee ittisa biyyaa haaraa mallatteessaniiru. Dhaabbanni Walta'iinsa Islaamaa tarkaanfii kana nageenya guutummaa addunyaa Islaamaatiif bu'uura guddaa dha jechuun galateeffateera. Ministirri Muummee kanaan duraa kan Kaataar Hamad bin Jaasim, walii galtichi abdii kan nama horatu fi tarkaanfii gaarii ta'uu isaa ibsaniiru.

title: US says it has redirected 51 vessels since reinstating Iran blockade
english: The U.S. Central Command reported that since July 14, they have enforced a naval blockade against Iran to restrict maritime activity. During this operation, U.S. forces successfully diverted 51 commercial ships and took direct action against four others by boarding or disabling them. This mission is part of an ongoing effort to monitor and control regional waters near Iranian ports.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ ከሐምሌ 14 ቀን ጀምሮ በኢራን ላይ የባህር ላይ እገዳ መጣሉን አስታውቋል። በዚህ ተልዕኮም 51 የንግድ መርከቦች ወደ ሌላ አቅጣጫ እንዲሄዱ የተደረገ ሲሆን፣ ሁለት መርከቦች እንዲቆሙ ሲደረግ ሌላ ሁለት መርከቦች ደግሞ ተፈትሸዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በአካባቢው ያሉ የኢራን ወደቦችን እና የባህር ዳርቻዎችን ለመቆጣጠር የታለመ ነው።
oromo: Ajajni giddugaleessa Ameerikaa (Centcom) akkuma Adoolessa 14 irraa eegalee Iranirratti qarqara galaanaatti daangaa kaa’uu isaa beeksiseera. Hojii kana keessatti, dooniiwwan daldalaa 51 gara karaa biraatti akka jijjiiraman taasifameera, akkasumas dooniiwwan biroo lama dhaabsisuu fi lama immoo seenanii sakatta’uun to’annoo jala oolchaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun buufataaleefi qarqara galaana Iranitti dhihoo jiran to’achuuf kan karoorfameedha.

title: Iranian parliamentary committee reviews draft bill to bar US, Israeli ships from Hormuz
english: A committee within the Iranian parliament is currently evaluating a proposal to prohibit ships from the U.S., Israel, and other nations deemed hostile from passing through the Strait of Hormuz. If this bill is passed, vessels that defy these restrictions could face significant financial penalties equal to one-fifth of their cargo's total value. The government is currently consulting with various experts to refine the details of the legislation before it moves forward.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ ኮሚቴ የአሜሪካ፣ የእስራኤል እና ሌሎች ጠላት ተብለው የተፈረጁ ሀገራት መርከቦች በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር እንዳያልፉ የሚከለክል ረቂቅ ህግ እያጠና ነው። ይህ ህግ ከፀደቀ፣ ክልከላውን የሚጥሱ መርከቦች የተሸከሙት እቃ ዋጋ እስከ 20 በመቶ የሚደርስ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ቅጣት ይጣልባቸዋል። ረቂቅ ህጉ በይፋ ከመጽደቁ በፊት ባለሙያዎች ምክረ ሃሳባቸውን እንዲሰጡበት እየተደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Koreen mana maree Iran, markaboonni Ameerikaa, Israa'el fi biyyoota diina jedhaman karaa galaana Hormuz akka hin dabarre dhorguuf seera qopheessaa jira. Seerri kun yoo mirkanaa'e, markaboonni dhorgaa kana cabsan gatii meeshaa fe'ataniirraa harka shan keessaa harka tokkoo (20%) adabbiin qarshii irratti murama. Seerichi osoo hin ragga'in dura, ogeeyyonni gorsa isaanii akka kennaniif carraan kennameera.

title: Democrats gain momentum in pivotal US Senate and governor’s races in Texas
english: Recent polling indicates that Democratic candidate James Talarico is gaining significant ground against Republican Ken Paxton in the Texas U.S. Senate race. These findings, which show Talarico leading among both independent and undecided voters, suggest that Texas could become a competitive battleground in the upcoming midterm elections. Democrats hope that these shifts in traditionally Republican areas will help them secure control of Congress to challenge the current administration's legislative goals.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ ጥናቶች እንደሚያሳዩት በቴክሳስ የአሜሪካ ሴኔት ምርጫ የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ እጩ ጄምስ ታላሪኮ ከሪፐብሊካኑ ኬን ፓክስተን ጋር ያላቸውን የድጋፍ ልዩነት በማጥበብ ግንባር ቀደም ሆነዋል። ይህ ውጤት፣ በተለይም ገለልተኛ መራጮች ለዴሞክራቶች ያላቸው ድጋፍ እየጨመረ መምጣቱን የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ በሪፐብሊካኖች ይዞታ በነበረችው ቴክሳስ ውስጥ የምርጫው ሁኔታ ተቀያሪ መሆኑን ያመላክታል። ዴሞክራቶች በዚህ ምርጫ የኮንግረስን ቁጥጥር በማሸነፍ የፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕን የአሰራር እቅዶች ለመግታት ተስፋ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Qorannoon dhihoo kun akka agarsiisutti, filannoo Senetii Ameerikaa kan biyya Texas keessatti kaadhimamaan paartii Dimokraata James Talarico morkataa isaa kan Ripablikan Ken Paxton caalaa deeggarsa argachaa jira. Qorannoon kun akka ibsutti, sagaleen namoota kallattii hin qabne fi murteessuu hin dandeenye gara Dimokraataatti dhihaachaa waan jiruuf, Texas kun boqonnaa filannoo kan mudannoo cimaa qabu ta'uu danda'a. Dimokraatonni filannoo kana injifachuun to'annoo Kongiresii fudhachuuf fi karoora seeraa kan pirezidanttii Trump ittisuuf abdatanii jiru.

title: Ethiopia’s National Dialogue Could Unravel the Federal Bargain
english: Ethiopia has launched a National Dialogue aimed at addressing long-standing political tensions, but many in the Somali region are concerned about the process. While the government promotes the initiative as a way to foster unity, Somalis fear it may be used to weaken the current federal system and strip away key constitutional protections like self-determination. They argue that the primary issue is not the constitution itself, but rather the government's failure to implement it fairly, leading to ongoing political and economic marginalization.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆዩ የፖለቲካ ውጥረቶችን ለመፍታት ብሔራዊ ምክክር ጀምራለች፣ ነገር ግን በሶማሌ ክልል የሚገኙ ብዙ ሰዎች በሂደቱ ላይ ስጋት አላቸው። መንግሥት ይህንን ተነሳሽነት አንድነትን ለመፍጠር እንደ መንገድ ቢገልጸውም፣ የሶማሌ ክልል ነዋሪዎች ሂደቱ አሁን ያለውን የፌዴራል ሥርዓት ለማዳከም እና እንደ ራስን በራስ የማስተዳደር ያሉ የሕገ መንግሥት መብቶችን ለመሸርሸር ሊውል ይችላል ብለው ይሰጋሉ። ችግሩ የሕገ መንግሥቱ ሳይሆን የመንግሥት አተገባበር መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ይህ አካሄድ የፖለቲካ እና የኢኮኖሚ መገለልን እንደሚያባብስ ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Itoophiyaan rakkoolee siyaasaa yeroo dheeraaf turan furuuf marii biyyaalessaa kan jalqabde yoo ta'u, jiraattonni naannoo Somaalee garuu adeemsa kana irratti yaaddoo qabu. Mootummaan mariin kun tokkummaa cimsuuf kan yaadame yoo jedhu, ummanni naannichaa garuu sirni federaalaa fi mirgoonni heeraa akka ofiin of bulchuu kanneen jedhaman akka laafatan sodaatu. Rakkoon inni guddaan heera keessa osoo hin taane, haala ittiin hojiirra oolu keessa akka jiru ibsuun, adeemsi kun miidhaa siyaasaa fi dinagdee daran akka hammaatuu fi mirga isaanii akka sarbu sodaatu.

title: Thai PM vows to introduce stricter gun laws after eight killed in shooting
english: Following a tragic shooting by a 14-year-old that left eight people dead near Bangkok, Thailand's Prime Minister has promised to implement tougher gun control measures. The proposed legislation aims to ban the public carrying of firearms, restricting access primarily to authorized government officials. This decision follows the teenager's use of a legally registered weapon belonging to his grandfather to attack his family members and school staff.
amharic: ባንኮክ አቅራቢያ በአንድ የ14 ዓመት ወጣት በተፈጸመ የጦር መሳሪያ ጥቃት ስምንት ሰዎች መገደላቸውን ተከትሎ የታይላንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጥብቅ የጦር መሳሪያ ቁጥጥር ህግ እንደሚያወጡ ቃል ገብተዋል። አዲሱ ረቂቅ ህግ ሲቪሎች በይፋዊ ቦታዎች ላይ መሳሪያ እንዳይዙ የሚከለክል ሲሆን፣ መሳሪያ የመያዝ መብቱንም ለመንግስት አካላት ብቻ ለመወሰን ያለመ ነው። ህጉ የወጣው ወጣቱ የአያቱን ህጋዊ መሳሪያ ተጠቅሞ በቤተሰቦቹና በትምህርት ቤት ሰራተኞች ላይ ጥቃት ከሰነዘረ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Magaalaa Baankook cinaatti dargaggeessi umuriin isaa waggaa 14 ta'e tokko namoota saddeet ajjeesuu hordofee, ministirri muummeen Taayilaand seera to'annoo meeshaa waraanaa cimsuuf waadaa galaniiru. Seerri haaraan kun namoonni dhuunfaa iddoo uummataa keessatti meeshaa waraanaa akka hin qabanne kan dhorku ta'ee, hayyamni qabachuu kan kennamuuf qaamota mootummaa qofaaf akka ta'uuf yaadameera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame dargaggeessi kun meeshaa akaakayyuu isaa seera qabeessa ta'e fayyadamee maatii isaa fi barsiistota irratti erga haleelee booda.

title: I was standing in front of my teacher when she was shot, Thai pupil says
english: A 14-year-old boy killed his grandparents and five teachers before shooting himself at a school near Bangkok. During the attack, terrified students were forced to flee by climbing over fences to escape the shooter, who moved between classrooms. At least 23 other people, including fellow students, sustained injuries during the tragic incident.
amharic: በባንኮክ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ ትምህርት ቤት የ14 ዓመት ታዳጊ ወጣቱ አያቶቹን እና አምስት መምህራንን ከገደለ በኋላ ራሱን አጥፍቷል። ጥቃቱ በሚፈጸምበት ወቅት፣ ተማሪዎች ተኩስ ከከፈተው ታዳጊ ለማምለጥ ከአጥር ላይ በመዝለል ተርፈዋል። በዚህ አሳዛኝ ድርጊት ከተማሪዎች ጋር ሌሎች 23 ሰዎች ለከባድ ጉዳት ተዳርገዋል።
oromo: Mana barumsaa Bangkok biraatti argamu tokkotti, dargaggeessi umuriin isaa 14 ta'e abbootii qabeenya isaa fi barsiisota shan erga ajjeese booda ofis of ajjeeseera. Yeroo haleellaan kun raawwatamutti, barattoonni sodaatan miidhaa irraa ooluuf dallaa irra utaaluun baqachuuf dirqamaniiru. Balaa gaddisiisaa kanaan barattoota dabalatee namoonni biroo 23 ta'an miidhamaniiru.

title: US appeals court halts White House ballroom construction
english: A federal appeals court has issued an order stopping the Trump administration's plan to build a $400 million ballroom at the White House. The project, which faced legal challenges, is currently suspended due to the court's decision. President Trump has stated that he intends to challenge this ruling by bringing the case before the United States Supreme Court.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የይግባኝ ሰሚ ፍርድ ቤት የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በኋይት ሀውስ ውስጥ ሊገነባ የነበረውን 400 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሚያወጣ የመዝናኛ አዳራሽ ግንባታ እንዲቆም ትእዛዝ ሰጠ። በህጋዊ ውዝግብ ውስጥ የነበረው ይህ ፕሮጀክት በፍርድ ቤቱ ውሳኔ መሰረት ታግዷል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የፍርድ ቤቱን ውሳኔ በመቃወም ጉዳዩን ወደ አሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት እንደሚወስዱት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mana murtii ol'aanaa Ameerikaa tokko mootummaan Trump akkaataa kanaan dura karoorfateen gamoofawwan 400 miiliyoona kan baasu mana taphaa (ballroom) Mana Adii keessatti ijaaruuf qabate akka dhaabu ajaje. Hojiin ijaarsaa kun mormii seeraa keessa kan ture yoo ta'u, ammaaf murtee mana murtiitiin dhaabatee jira. Pirezidaant Trump murtee kana mormuudhaan dhimma kana gara Mana Murtii Ol'aanaa Ameerikaatti akka geessan ibsaniiru.

title: South Koreans beat the heat with ‘silent disco’ pool party
english: To escape a severe heatwave in South Korea, residents in Seoul participated in a unique silent disco pool party. Participants wore headphones to listen to music while dancing in the water, which allowed them to stay cool without creating noise for the neighborhood. This creative event provided a refreshing break as temperatures in some areas climbed as high as 42.5 degrees Celsius.
amharic: በደቡብ ኮሪያ አገሪቱን ባጠቃው ከፍተኛ የሙቀት መጠን ምክንያት የሴኡል ነዋሪዎች ልዩ የሆነ የገንዳ ውስጥ 'ሳይለንት ዲስኮ' ድግስ አዘጋጅተዋል። ተሳታፊዎች በውሃ ውስጥ ሆነው ሙዚቃውን በጆሮ ማዳመጫ የሚያዳምጡበት ይህ ዝግጅት፣ አካባቢውን ሳይረብሹ በደስታ እንዲቀዘቅዙ አስችሏቸዋል። በደቡባዊ የሀገሪቱ ክፍል የሙቀት መጠኑ እስከ 42.5 ዲግሪ ሴልሺየስ በመድረሱ፣ ይህ መዝናኛ የሙቀት ማስታገሻ መንገድ ሆኖ አገልግሏል።
oromo: Koree Kibbaatti hongee cimaa mudateen walqabatee, jiraattonni Seoul uffata gurraa fayyadamuun bashannana 'silent disco' jedhamu qopheeffatan. Namoonni bashannana kana irratti hirmaatan, sagalee guddaa hin uumneen bishaan keessatti sirbuudhaan of qabbaneessan. Godinoota biyyattii tokko tokkotti ho’inni isaa hanga digirii 42.5 ga’ee waan tureef, bashannanni kun namootaaf furmaata gaarii ta’ee jira.

title: Kidnapped rare Serbian eagle freed into wild after rescue
english: A rare eastern imperial eagle named Feliks was successfully released into the wild in Serbia following a long rescue operation. The bird was captured by poachers in the Middle East, who demanded a ransom that conservationists refused to pay. After extensive negotiations and a period of rehabilitation in Lebanon and at a Serbian zoo, the endangered raptor has finally returned to its natural habitat.
amharic: ፌሊክስ የተባለ ብርቅዬ የምስራቅ ንጉሳዊ ንስር ለረጅም ጊዜ በቆየ የነፍስ አድን ስራ ከጠላፊዎች ተለቆ ወደ ተፈጥሯዊ መኖሪያው ተመልሷል። ወፉ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ በአዳኞች ተይዞ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ የጥበቃ ባለሙያዎች ለጠላፊዎቹ የሚጠይቁትን ገንዘብ ለመክፈል ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም። ረጅም ድርድር እና በሊባኖስና በሰርቢያ የእንስሳት ማቆያ ውስጥ ከተደረገለት የጤና ክትትል በኋላ፣ ይህ ለአደጋ የተጋለጠ ወፍ በድጋሚ ወደ ተፈጥሮ ተቀላቅሏል።
oromo: Sooda (eagle) gosa guddaa fi gartuu ta'e Feliks jedhamu tokko, qabamee erga baatiiwwan hedduu darban booda gara bosonaatti deebi'eera. Sanyii kana kan qaban namoonni bineensa kiyyeessan gatii guddaa gaafatanis, bakka buutonni eegumsa bineensotaa kaffaltii kana didaniiru. Hojiin marii fi yaalii fayyaa erga godhameefii booda, soodaan kun boqonnaa erga fudhate booda gara qilleensa bilisaatti gadhiifameera.

title: Lebanon points to ‘positive progress’ on borders, prisoners in Israel talks
english: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun has reported optimistic progress in recent diplomatic talks with Israel regarding border disputes and prisoner swaps. While these negotiations show promise, the military situation remains tense as ongoing Israeli airstrikes and shelling continue to hit southern Lebanon. Despite the hope for a ceasefire and practical solutions, local residents and authorities remain concerned due to continued attacks on civilian infrastructure and military personnel.
amharic: የሊባኖስ ፕሬዝዳንት ጆሴፍ አውን ከእስራኤል ጋር በተደረጉ የድንበር እና የእስረኞች ልውውጥ ድርድሮች ላይ አዎንታዊ መሻሻሎች መኖራቸውን ገልጸዋል። በዲፕሎማሲው ረገድ ተስፋ ሰጪ ነገሮች ቢታዩም፣ በእስራኤል በኩል የሚሰነዘሩ የአየር እና የመድፍ ጥቃቶች በሊባኖስ ደቡባዊ ክፍል ቀጥለዋል። የጦር መቋረጥ ስምምነት ይደረሳል የሚል ተስፋ ቢኖርም፣ በሲቪል መሠረተ ልማቶች እና በወታደሮች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለው ጥቃት ስጋትን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Liibaanoos Jooseef Aawun marii Israa'el waliin daangaa fi jijjiirraa hidhattootaa irratti taasisaniin guddina gaarii galmeessuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Karaa diippilomaasii kanaan abdii guddaan kan jiru ta'us, haleellaan xiyyaaraa fi meeshaa gurguddaa Israa'el gama kibba Liibaanoositti gaggeessitu itti fufee jira. Waraana dhaabuu irratti abdii qabanillee, haleellaan bu'uuraalee misoomaa fi loltoota irratti raawwatamu guutummaatti dhaabbachuu dhabuun isaa sodaa uumee jira.

title: Ebola cases top 4,000 in DRC as WHO urges Ervebo vaccine trial
english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing a rapidly escalating Ebola outbreak that has infected over 4,000 people and caused 1,850 deaths since May. Because the current Bundibugyo strain lacks a specific vaccine, the World Health Organization is calling for clinical trials to test if the existing Ervebo vaccine can provide protection. The epidemic is currently the second largest on record and continues to spread through several provinces despite ongoing response efforts.
amharic: በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የተከሰተው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ከግንቦት ወር ጀምሮ ከ4,000 በላይ ሰዎችን በማጥቃት 1,850 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት ዳርጓል። አሁን እየተስፋፋ ያለው የኢቦላ ዝርያ መከላከያ ክትባት የሌለው በመሆኑ፣ የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት የኤርቬቦ ክትባት ለዚህ በሽታ ውጤታማ መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ በሰው ላይ የሙከራ ምርምር እንዲደረግ አሳስቧል። ይህ ወረርሽኝ በታሪክ ከተመዘገቡት የኢቦላ ወረርሽኞች በሁለተኛ ደረጃ የሚቀመጥ ሲሆን፣ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች በፍጥነት በመስፋፋት ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Jamhuuriyya Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti dhukkubni Ebola weerara cimaa fidaa jiraachuu isaatiin namoonni 4,000 ol qabamanii 1,850 immoo du'aniiru. Weerarri amma jiru kun gosa vaayirasii 'Bundibugyo' jedhamu waan ta'eefifi talaalliin isaa waan hin jirreef, Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa talaallii 'Ervebo' jedhamu kana namoota irratti yaaluuf karoorfateera. Weerarri kun kan guddinaan lammaffaa ta'ee fi saffisa guddaadhaan naannolee garaagaraa keessatti babal'ataa jira.

title: Can diplomacy end the conflict in Libya?
english: Libya has remained split between two competing governments since 2014, with years of international mediation efforts failing to resolve the instability. Currently, new diplomatic initiatives led by the United States and Turkey are attempting to establish a power-sharing agreement to unite the country. Analysts remain cautious about whether these efforts will foster lasting peace or inadvertently trigger further violence.
amharic: ሊቢያ ከ2014 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ በሁለት ተቀናቃኝ መንግስታት የተከፈለች ሲሆን፣ እስካሁን የተደረጉ ዓለም አቀፍ የሰላም ጥረቶች ሁሉ ስኬታማ አልሆኑም። በአሁኑ ወቅት አሜሪካ እና ቱርክ ሀገሪቱን ለማስታረቅ እና ስልጣን ለመጋራት የሚያስችል አዲስ የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። ይሁን እንጂ ባለሙያዎች ይህ ሂደት ዘላቂ ሰላም ያመጣል ወይስ ዳግም ግጭትን ይጭራል የሚለው ጉዳይ አጠያያቂ መሆኑን ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Libiyaan bara 2014 irraa eegalee mootummoota wal dorgoman lamaan kan gargar baate yoo ta'u, yaaliin nageenyaa idil-addunyaa hanga ammaatti taasifame hundinuu bu'aa dhabeera. Amma garuu, Ameerikaa fi Turkeen biyyattii walitti fiduuf fi aango wal qooduuf karoorawwan haaraa irratti hojjetaa jiru. Ta'us, yaaliiwwan kunneen nageenya waaraa ni fidu moo waraana biraatti nu geessu kan jedhu irratti hayyoonni shakkiin isaanii itti fufeera.

title: US appeals court upholds injunction pausing Trump’s White House ballroom
english: A US appeals court has blocked President Donald Trump's plans to build a new ballroom at the White House by upholding an injunction against the project. The majority ruling emphasized that the President lacks the legal authority to unilaterally demolish historical sections of the building without prior approval from Congress. The court stated that such construction would cause irreversible damage to the historic site, asserting that major changes to the White House must be decided by lawmakers rather than the executive branch.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የይግባኝ ሰሚ ፍርድ ቤት ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኋይት ሀውስ ውስጥ አዳራሽ ለመገንባት ያቀዱትን እቅድ በጊዜያዊነት አግዷል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ፕሬዝዳንቱ የሕግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤቱን ፈቃድ ሳያገኙ ታሪካዊውን ሕንፃ የማፍረስ መብት እንደሌላቸው ገልጿል። የሕንፃው ለውጦች በፕሬዝዳንቱ ሳይሆን በሕግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤቱ መወሰን እንዳለባቸውና ይህ ግንባታ ታሪካዊ ቅርሱ ላይ የማይተካ ጉዳት እንደሚያደርስ ፍርድ ቤቱ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mana murtii ol'aanaa Ameerikaa tokko, pirezidaant Doonaald Traamp mana qophii (ballroom) Mana Adii keessatti ijaaruuf karoorfataniif dhorkaa kuteera. Murtiin kun kan ibsu, pirezidaantichi hayyama Kongireesii malee kutaa seena-qabeessa Mana Adii diiguuf aangoo akka hin qabne dha. Mana murtichaa akka jedhetti, jijjiiramni guddaan Mana Adii irratti godhamu kan murtaa'u Kongireesiin malee qaama raawwachiiftuudhaan miti; akkasumas ijaarsi kun seenaa bakkeecichaarratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu danda'a.

title: Home catches fire, as Israel shells Lebanon’s al-Mansouri
english: Israeli military forces conducted intense artillery strikes on the southern Lebanese town of al-Mansouri. According to local reports, the shelling caused a residential home to erupt in flames. There have been no further details provided regarding potential casualties.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በምትገኘው አል-ማንሱሪ ከተማ ላይ ከፍተኛ የከባድ መሳሪያ ተኩስ ከፍተዋል። በአካባቢው የተገኙ መረጃዎች እንደሚያመለክቱት፣ በተኩሱ ምክንያት አንድ የመኖሪያ ቤት በእሳት ተቃጥሏል። ስለደረሰው የሰው ህይወት ጉዳት እስካሁን የተገለጸ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el magaalaa Kibba Libaanoos kan taate al-Maansuurii irratti rukuttaa meeshaa gurguddaan haleellaa cimaa raawwataniiru. Gabaasoonni naannichaa akka ibsanitti, haleellaa kanaan mana jireenya tokko irra ibidni ga'ee gubateera. Miidhaa lubbuu qaqabe ilaalchisee hanga ammaatti odeeffannoon dabalataa hin kennamne.

title: Turkey says new defence pact aligns with Nato commitments
english: The Turkish government has clarified that its recent defense deal with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan does not violate its obligations to NATO. Officials emphasized that this partnership is meant to improve regional security rather than serve as a replacement for their NATO membership. This statement was issued to dismiss rumors suggesting that the agreement conflicted with Turkey's existing international alliances.
amharic: የቱርክ መንግስት ከሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ከፓኪስታን ጋር የፈረመው አዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ከኔቶ ህብረት ጋር ያለውን ግዴታ እንደማይቃረን አስታውቋል። ባለስልጣናቱ ይህ አጋርነት የኔቶ አባልነትን ለመተካት ሳይሆን የክልሉን ደህንነት ለማጠናከር ያለመ መሆኑን አብራርተዋል። መግለጫው የወጣው ስምምነቱ ከቱርክ የውጭ ግንኙነት መርሆዎች ጋር ይቃረናል የሚሉ ሀሰተኛ ወሬዎችን ለመካድ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Turkii waliigalteen ittisaa biyyoota Sa'udii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan wajjin taasise, dirqama isaan NATO wajjin qaban kan hin cabsin ta'uu ibseera. Hoji gaggeessitootni akka jedhanitti, tumaan kun miseensa NATO ta'uu isaanii bakka bu'uuf osoo hin taane, nageenya naannichaa cimsuuf kan karoorfameedha. Ibsi kun kan kenname, waliigalteen kun walitti dhufeenya biyyattii kan biroo wajjin wal-faalleessa kan jedhu odeeffannoo dharaa sirreessuufidha.

title: Iran's Araghchi praises military, urges Muslim unity
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi recently highlighted the strength of Iran's military capabilities against powerful global adversaries. He also called for greater cooperation among Muslim nations to maintain self-reliance and resist foreign interference. This message followed a new defense agreement signed by Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ የኢራን ወታደራዊ ኃይል በዓለም ላይ ካሉ ኃያላን ጋር ለመጋፈጥ ዝግጁ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። የሙስሊም አገራት በውጫዊ ተጽዕኖዎች ላይ ያላቸውን ጥገኝነት በመቀነስ በአንድነት እንዲቆሙም ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይህ አስተያየት የመጣው ሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ፓኪስታን እና ቱርክ አዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ከተፈራረሙ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbas Araagchii, humnoonni waraana biyyattii diina cimaa dura dhaabbachuuf qophaa'oo akka ta'an ibsaniiru. Biyyoonni Islaamaa waliin ta'uudhaan ofitti amanamummaa qabaachuu fi dhiibbaa alaa of irraa ittisuu akka qaban dhaamaniiru. Yaanni kun kan dhufe erga Sa'udii Arabiyaan, Paakistaanii fi Turkii waliigaltee waraanaa haaraa mallatteessanii boodadha.

title: US official: 'We expect a deal soon' between Iran and Oman on Strait of Hormuz
english: A United States official recently stated that Iran and Oman are close to reaching an agreement regarding navigation in the Strait of Hormuz. Once this deal is finalized to ensure that commercial ships can pass through the area without interference, the U.S. intends to end its blockade of Iranian ports. This move is expected to improve maritime trade conditions in the region significantly.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የንግድ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ተቃርበዋል። ስምምነቱ ሲጸድቅ እና የንግድ መርከቦች ያለ ምንም እንቅፋት ማለፍ ሲችሉ አሜሪካ በኢራን ወደቦች ላይ የጣለችውን እገዳ እንደምታነሳ ታውቋል። ይህ እርምጃ በክልሉ ያለውን የባህር ንግድ እንቅስቃሴ ለማሻሻል ይረዳል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mootummaa Ameerikaa akka ibsanitti, biyyoonni Iraan fi Omaaniin dhimma geejjiba markeebotaa kan Galaana Hormuz irratti walii galtee irra gahuuf jedhu. Walii galteen kun erga mallatteeffamee booda, markeebonni daldalaa gufuu tokko malee akka darban waan taasisuuf, Ameerikaan dhaabbilee markeebota Iraan irra kaastee jirtu ni kaasti. Tarkaanfiin kun daldala galaana irraa naannichaa foyyeessuuf ni gargaara.

title: US Treasury targets crypto exchanges in new Iran sanctions
english: The U.S. Treasury has imposed sanctions on a Dubai-based cryptocurrency exchange called Shelbit for allegedly facilitating millions of dollars in illegal transactions for Iran’s Revolutionary Guard. This action follows reports that the platform acted as a central hub for bypassing international sanctions through shadow banking networks. U.S. officials also sanctioned the exchange’s founder, Siavash Kayvanpour, as part of a broader effort to disrupt Iranian financial activities supported by digital assets.

oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa dhaabbata al-seeraa gabaa kriptoo-kareensii Dubaay keessatti argamu, kan ‘Shelbit’ jedhamu irratti tarkaanfii fudhateera. Dhaabbatichi garee waraana Iiraan kan ‘Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps’ jedhamuuf malaammaltummaa fi gargaarsa maallaqaa seeraan alaa miliyoonaan lakkaa’amu akka taasise himameera. Mootummaan Ameerikaa hundeesse dhaabbatichaa Siavash Kayvanpour irrattis maallaqa Iiraan maallaqa dijitaalaatti fayyadamuun adabbiiwwan idil-addunyaa akka darbu taasisuu isaa hordofee adabbii kana murteesseera.

title: Contaminated water putting Gaza families at risk
english: Families in Gaza are facing a severe health crisis due to the destruction of essential water infrastructure. With pumping stations, wells, and treatment systems broken, residents are left without access to clean drinking water. This lack of sanitation and safe supplies significantly increases the danger of widespread disease throughout the region.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ቤተሰቦች የውሃ መሠረተ ልማቶች በመውደማቸው ምክንያት ለከባድ የጤና ችግር ተጋልጠዋል። የውሃ ማጠቢያ ጣቢያዎች፣ ጉድጓዶች እና የውሃ ማጣሪያዎች በመፍረሳቸው ነዋሪዎች ንጹህ የመጠጥ ውሃ ማግኘት አልቻሉም። ይህ የመሠረታዊ አገልግሎቶች እጥረት በክልሉ ውስጥ ለበሽታዎች መዛመት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Maatiin Gaaza keessa jiraatan bu'uuraalee misooma bishaanii barbadaa'uun walqabatee rakkoo fayyaa cimaaf saaxilamaniiru. Buufataaleen bishaanii, boollonni fi sirnoota qulqullina bishaanii waan miidhamaniif, jiraattonni bishaan dhugaatii qulqulluun argachuu hin dandeenye. Rakkoon dhabama tajaajila bu'uuraa kunis naannichatti dhukkuboonni akka babal'ataniif soda guddaa uumee jira.

title: DR Congo releases 15 prisoners to M23 rebels as part of Doha peace process
english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has released 15 prisoners to the M23 rebel group as part of a peace agreement mediated by Qatar. The International Committee of the Red Cross facilitated the transfer, moving the detainees from Beni to rebel-held territory. This act is seen as a significant confidence-building measure intended to help end the ongoing conflict in the eastern part of the country.
amharic: የኮንጎ ዲሞክራሲያዊ ሪፐብሊክ በኳታር አደራዳሪነት በተደረሰው የሰላም ስምምነት መሰረት 15 እስረኞችን ለኤም 23 አማፂ ቡድን አስረክባለች። የዓለም አቀፉ የቀይ መስቀል ኮሚቴ እስረኞቹን ከቤኒ ከተማ ወደ አማፂያኑ ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው አካባቢ በማጓጓዝ ሂደቱን አቀላጥፏል። ይህ እርምጃ በሀገሪቱ ምስራቃዊ ክፍል ያለውን ግጭት ለመፍታት እና በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል መተማመንን ለመገንባት እንደ ትልቅ ስኬት ታይቷል።
oromo: Jamhuuriyya Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti, walii galtee nagaa Kaataar giddu galeessa taateen mallatteeffame hordofee, namoota hidhamanii turan 15 garee finxaaleyyii M23tti dabarsitee kenniteetti. Koomishiniin Fannoo Diimaa Addunyaa hidhamtoota kana magaalaa Benii irraa gara naannoo finxaaleyyoon sun to'ataniitti geejjibsiisuun walharkaa fuudhinsa kana raawwateera. Tarkaanfiin kun gareewwan wal lolan gidduutti amanannaa uumuufi bu'uura nagaa biyyattii gama bahaa deebisuuf kan gumaachu ta'uun ibsameera.

title: Several killed in attacks on Ukraine as Kyiv hits Russian e-commerce giant
english: A series of intense attacks between Russia and Ukraine has resulted in at least six deaths and many injuries across several Ukrainian regions. While Russia continues to strike residential and civilian areas with drones and artillery, Ukraine has retaliated by targeting Russian logistics hubs, including the e-commerce giant Wildberries. Meanwhile, President Zelenskyy is visiting Serbia to strengthen economic and political ties, a move expected to cause tension with Moscow.
amharic: በሩሲያ እና በዩክሬን መካከል እየተካሄደ ያለው ተከታታይ ጥቃት በበርካታ የዩክሬን አካባቢዎች ቢያንስ ስድስት ሰዎችን ለሞት እና ለብዙዎች ለጉዳት ዳርጓል። ሩሲያ በድሮን እና በከባድ መሳሪያዎች የመኖሪያ ቤቶችን እና የሲቪል አካባቢዎችን ማጥቃቷን ስትቀጥል፣ ዩክሬን ደግሞ የሩሲያን የሎጂስቲክስ ማዕከላት እና የንግድ ተቋማትን ኢላማ በማድረግ አጸፋዊ እርምጃ እየወሰደች ነው። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ፣ ፕሬዚዳንት ዘለንስኪ ኢኮኖሚያዊ እና ፖለቲካዊ ትብብርን ለማጠናከር ሰርቢያን እየጎበኙ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ጉብኝት በሞስኮ ዘንድ ቅሬታን ይፈጥራል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Harka lachuu gidduutti waraanni cimaan geggeeffamaa jiru kun naannolee Yukreen gara garaa keessatti namoota hedduu ajjeeseera. Raashiyaan xiyyaara maleeyyuu (drones) fi meeshaa waraanaan bakkeewwan jireenyaa fi siivilii miidhuu yeroo itti fuftu, Yukreen immoo haala waraana Raashiyaa gargaaru jedhamanii kan amanaman bakkeewwan gurgurtaa fi buufataalee lojistiksii irratti haleellaa deebistee geggeessaa jirti. Gama biraatiin, Pireezidaant Zeelenskiin hariiroo diinagdee fi siyaasaa cimsuuf biyya Serbiyaa daawwachaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, tarkaanfiin kun Raashiyaa biratti mufannaa akka uumu irraa hubatama.

title: Inside the results: How redistricting shaped Tennessee’s primary election
english: Tennessee recently held its first primary election using a new congressional map that was redrawn to potentially favor Republican candidates. This redistricting process notably split a majority-Black district in Memphis, impacting the political landscape for the upcoming midterm elections. As Republicans aim to maintain their slim control of the US House, these primary results finalized the candidates who will compete for leadership roles in November.

oromo: Teennesiin dhiheenya kana filannoo sadarkaa duraa kan godhatte kaartaa daangaa filannoo haaraa itti fayyadamuun yoo ta'u, kaartiin kunis garee Rippabilikaanootaaf faayidaa akka argamsiisuuf kan qophaaye dha. title: Yemen’s Houthis claim attack on Marib hit Saudi-backed forces
english: Houthi rebels in Yemen have announced a military strike against forces supported by Saudi Arabia near the city of Marib. The group claims to have destroyed military gear and supply centers during the operation. Furthermore, the Houthis have warned that they will persist in targeting Saudi-backed troops to challenge the ongoing blockade of their territory.
amharic: የየመኑ ሁቲ አማፂያን በማሪብ ከተማ አቅራቢያ በሳውዲ አረቢያ በሚደገፉ ኃይሎች ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ቡድኑ በዚሁ ጥቃት ወታደራዊ መሣሪያዎችን እና የጦር መጋዘኖችን ማውደሙን ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም የየመንን ድንበር ዘግተው የያዙ ኃይሎችን መታገላቸውን እንደሚቀጥሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Humni Houtii kan Yemen, loltoota Sa’udii Arabiyaan deggeraman kan magaala Marib bira jiran irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaa beeksise. Gareen kun haleellaa kanaan meeshaalee waraanaa fi kuusaa waraanaa barbadeessuu isaa ibseera. Akkasumas, Houtiin biyyattii irratti duula gaggeeffamaa jiru mormuuf jecha, humni Sa’udii fi tumsa isaa irratti haleellaa itti fufsiisuu akka barbaadan akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Lebanon, Israel agree shortlist of countries that could send troops to verify Hezbollah disarmament
english: Lebanon and Israel have established a list of potential countries that could monitor the disarmament of Hezbollah as part of a US-brokered agreement. The United States will make the final selection from this list, which excludes nations rejected by either side. Although this deal aims to facilitate an Israeli troop withdrawal, Hezbollah remains opposed to disarming.
amharic: ሊባኖስ እና እስራኤል በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት ሂዝቦላህ ትጥቅ መፍታቱን የሚቆጣጠሩ ሀገራትን ዝርዝር አዘጋጅተዋል። አሜሪካ ከሁለቱም ወገኖች ተቀባይነት ካላቸው ሀገራት መካከል የመጨረሻውን ምርጫ ታደርጋለች። ይህ ስምምነት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ከሊባኖስ እንዲወጡ ለማድረግ የታቀደ ቢሆንም፣ ሂዝቦላህ ግን ትጥቅ ለመፍታት ፈቃደኛ አይደለም።
oromo: Libanoos fi Israa'el gargaarsa Ameerikaatiin gareen 'Hezbollah' hidhannoo hiikuu isaa kan hordofan biyyoota filatan irratti walii galaniiru. Ameerikaan biyyoota kanneen keessaa filannoo dhumaa kan gootu yoo ta'u, biyyoonni garee lamaanuu irraa mormii qaban tarree kana keessa hin jiran. Walii galteen kun waraanni Israa'el Libanoos keessaa akka ba'u kan tumu ta'us, Hezbollah garuu hidhannoo hiikuuf fedhii hin qabu.

title: Israeli forces beat and detain Palestinian during settler attack near Nablus
english: Israeli troops and settlers carried out a raid in the West Bank town of Beit Furik, resulting in the assault and arrest of a Palestinian man in his forties. Medical workers reported that military forces blocked their ambulance from providing assistance to the victim. Additionally, settlers caused damage to local homes and security equipment during the violent unrest in the area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ሰፋሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ በምትገኘው በቤት ፉሪክ ከተማ ባደረጉት ጥቃት በአርባዎቹ ዕድሜ ውስጥ የሚገኝ አንድ ፍልስጤማዊ ተደብድቦ ታስሯል። የህክምና ቡድኖች እንደገለጹት ወታደሮቹ የአምቡላንስ ተሽከርካሪ በጉዳት ላይ ወደነበረው ሰው እንዳይደርስ አግደዋል። በዚሁ ወቅት ሰፋሪዎች በአካባቢው ያሉ ቤቶችን እና የክትትል ካሜራዎችን በማውደም በነዋሪዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el fi qubattoonni biyya lafaa magaalaa Beit Furik keessatti raawwatanin, dhiirri umriin isaa waggaa afurtamoota keessatti argamu tokko reebamee hidhameera. Hojjettoonni fayyaa akka ibsanitti, waraanni Israa'el ambulaansii miidhamaa sana gargaaruuf deemutti gufuu ta'aniiru. Kana malees, qubattoonni kun manneen jireenyaa fi kaameraa to'annoo naannichaa mancaasuu isaanii gabaasni ni mul'isa.

title: Exclusive: ICC judges order Taliban case split from Afghanistan probe that covers US troops
english: The International Criminal Court has decided to separate investigations into gender-based persecution by the Taliban from the wider probe into war crimes in Afghanistan. This change means the Taliban-specific allegations will be handled independently from inquiries involving U.S. military and CIA personnel. Critics worry this move might be an attempt to improve relations with Washington by distancing the court from investigations into American citizens.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት በታሊባን ላይ የሚቀርቡ የሥርዓተ-ፆታ ጭቆና ክሶችን ከአፍጋኒስታን ሰፊው የጦር ወንጀል ምርመራ ለይቶ እንዲመለከት ወስኗል። ይህ ውሳኔ የታሊባን ጉዳዮች ከአሜሪካ ወታደሮች እና ከሲአይኤ ጋር ከተያያዙ ጉዳዮች ተለይተው እንዲታዩ ያደርጋል። ይህ እርምጃ ፍርድ ቤቱ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማለዘብ ሲል ከአሜሪካውያን ጋር የተያያዙ ምርመራዎችን ለመተው መዘጋጀቱን የሚያሳይ እንደሆነ እየተነገረ ነው።
oromo: Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa, himannaa ari’annaa saalaan walqabatee garee Taaliban irratti dhiyaatu, qorannoo waraana Afgaanistaan waliigalaa irraa gargar baasee akka ilaalu murteesseera. Jijjiiramni kun himannaan Taaliban irratti qabu, qorannoo waraana Ameerikaa fi hojjettoota CIA irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru irraa adda ta’ee akka ilaalamu taasisa. Tarkaanfiin kun, mana murtichaa qorannoo lammiilee Ameerikaa irratti gaggeeffamu dhaabuun waldhabdee Waashingitan waliin jiru tasgabbeessuuf yaalii akka ta’e yaadama.

title: Anti-Muslim lawmaker Andy Ogles loses Republican primary
english: Tennessee Congressman Andy Ogles, known for his harsh anti-Muslim rhetoric, was defeated in the Republican primary by farmer Charlie Hatcher. Despite receiving an endorsement from Donald Trump, Ogles lost to Hatcher, who benefited from significant outside funding and a focus on agricultural issues. The election outcome followed recent district boundary changes and growing public criticism of Ogles' inflammatory statements regarding Muslim Americans.
amharic: በእስልምና እምነት ተከታዮች ላይ በሚያደርሱት አጸያፊ ንግግሮች የሚታወቁት የቴነሲው የኮንግረስ አባል አንዲ ኦግልስ፣ በሪፐብሊካን የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ምርጫ ተሸንፈዋል። ምንም እንኳን የዶናልድ ትራምፕ ድጋፍ ቢኖራቸውም፣ ኦግልስ በገበሬው ቻርሊ ሃቸር ተሸንፈዋል። የሃቸር ድል በምርጫ ክልል ድንበር ላይ በተደረጉ ለውጦች እና ኦግልስ በሙስሊሞች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ አክራሪ ንግግሮች ባስከተሉት ተቃውሞ የተነሳ እንደሆነ ተጠቅሷል።
oromo: Miseensi Kongirasii Teenesii kan ta'an Andy Ogles, ibsawwan Islaamummaa irratti xiyyeeffatan qaban irraa kan ka'e, filannoo duraa paartii Rippaabilikaanii keessatti injifatamaniiru. Deggersa Donald Traamp qabaachuu isaanii irra iyyuu, Ogles qonnaan bulaa Charlie Hatcher irratti injifatamuun isaanii dinqisiisaa ta'eera. Injifannoon Hatcher jijjiirama daangaa ganda filannoo fi ibsawwan jibbinsaa Ogles gareewwan amantii Islaamaa irratti dabarsaa turanirratti mormiin uumamuun kan dhufedha.

title: New Delhi on red alert as heavy rains pound the city
english: Severe rainfall has hit New Delhi and surrounding areas, leading to significant transportation delays and stranded residents in flood-prone zones. Authorities have officially declared a red alert for the city due to the extreme weather conditions. Meteorologists expect the heavy downpours to continue until the situation gradually improves by Sunday.
amharic: በኒው ዴልሂ እና በአካባቢዋ ባጋጠመው ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት የመንገድ ትራንስፖርት ተስተጓጉሎ ነዋሪዎች ችግር ውስጥ ወድቀዋል። የሕንድ የአየር ንብረት ቢሮ በአካባቢው ከፍተኛ አደጋ እንደሚኖር የሚያሳይ የቀይ ማስጠንቀቂያ አውጇል። ይህ የአየር ሁኔታ እስከ እሁድ ድረስ እንደሚቀጥል እና ከዚያ በኋላ እንደሚሻሻል ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Roobni cimaan magaalaa Niiw Deelhiifi naannawwii ishee mudatee jiru, geejjiba guutuutti dhaabuun namoota bakka gad-aanaa jiraatan miidhee jira. Biiroon qilleensa-galchii Indiyaa balaa roobichaan walqabatee akeekkachiisa cimaa (red alert) labseera. Haalli kun hanga Dilbatti kan itti fufuufi booda immoo kan tasgabbaa'u ta'uu ibsameera.

title: Mediterranean smuggling network ‘dismantled’ in Spain-led raid, 78 arrested
english: Spanish authorities and international partners have successfully dismantled a major criminal organization responsible for smuggling thousands of migrants, drugs, and weapons across the Mediterranean. The operation led to 78 arrests and the seizure of 18 high-speed boats used to transport people in dangerous, inhumane conditions. This criminal network generated over 24 million euros by operating sophisticated routes between Algeria and Spain.
amharic: የስፔን ባለስልጣናት ከአለም አቀፍ አጋሮቻቸው ጋር በመተባበር በሜዲትራኒያን ባህር በኩል በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ ስደተኞችን፣ አደንዛዥ እጾችን እና መሳሪያዎችን ሲያዘዋውር የነበረ ትልቅ የወንጀል ቡድንን መበተን ችለዋል። በዚህ ኦፕሬሽን 78 ሰዎች በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሲሆን ለስደተኞች ማጓጓዣነት ያገለግሉ የነበሩ 18 ፈጣን ጀልባዎችም ተይዘዋል። ይህ ቡድን ከአልጄሪያ ወደ ስፔን በሚያደርገው ህገ-ወጥ እንቅስቃሴ ከ24 ሚሊዮን ዩሮ በላይ ማትረፉንና በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ለአደጋ ማጋለጡን ባለስልጣናት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Ispeen qindeessummaa dhaabbilee idil-addunyaa waliin ta'uun, garee yakkaatiifi nama baqachiisuu, darbuu darawaa fi meeshaa waraanaa daangaa galaana Mediteraniyaa irra deddeebii raawwataa ture tokko diiguu danda'aniiru. Tarkaanfii kana keessatti namoonni 78 to'annoo jala oolaniiru akkasumas dooniiwwan namoota dawoo hin qabne keessatti fe'uun balaa keessa buusaa turan 18 ta'an qabamaniiru. Gareen yakkaa kun karaa biyyoota Aljeeriyaafi Ispeen gidduu jiru fayyadamuun qarshii Yuuroo miliyoona 24 ol argachaa kan ture yoo ta'u, namoota kumaatamaan lakka'amanis balaa guddaa keessa buusa turan.

title: Spanish police arrest 78 people in bust of 'one of largest' smuggling networks
english: Spanish and Algerian authorities have dismantled a major criminal syndicate involved in trafficking drugs, weapons, and migrants across the Mediterranean. The group used high-speed, unregistered boats to move illicit goods and people, charging migrants large sums for dangerous sea crossings. During the extensive operation, police arrested 78 suspects and seized significant assets, including millions of euros worth of vessels and various illegal narcotics.
amharic: የስፔን እና የአልጄሪያ ባለስልጣናት በመካከለኛው ባህር ላይ አደንዛዥ እጾችን፣ የጦር መሳሪያዎችን እና ስደተኞችን በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ ሲያዘዋውር የነበረ ትልቅ የወንጀል ቡድን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ቡድኑ በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ የተመዘገቡ ፈጣን ጀልባዎችን በመጠቀም ሰዎችን እና እቃዎችን በድብቅ ያዘዋውር የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ስደተኞችንም ለከፍተኛ ገንዘብ አጋልጠው ነበር። በተካሄደው የተቀናጀ ኦፕሬሽን 78 ተጠርጣሪዎች በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሲሆን በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠር ዩሮ የሚገመቱ ጀልባዎች እና የተለያዩ ህገ-ወጥ እቃዎች ተይዘዋል።
oromo: Mootummoonni Ispeenii fi Aljeeriyaa garee yakkaa guddaa qoricha sammua namaa hadoochu, meeshaa waraanaa fi godaantota garba karaa Meditiraaneenii ceesisaa ture to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Gareen kun dooniiwwan ariitii olaanaa qabanii fi seeraan ala ta'an fayyadamuun namaa fi meeshaa seeraan ala akka ce'an gochuun, godaantota irraas maallaqa guddaa fudhachaa turaniiru. Hojii qindaa'aa kanaan shakkamtoonni 78 to'atamanii, dooniiwwan gatiin isaanii miliyoonaan lakkaa'amu fi meeshaaleen seeraan alaa garaa garaa qabamaniiru.
